direct_answer_heading: What you should confirm before moving to Aveiro
key_points_heading: Information needed to receive useful quotes
faq_heading: Questions about moving services in aveiro
direct_answer: Indicate the specific collection and delivery area, the date, inventory, floors, lifts, stairs and where the vehicle can stop. Also inform the manual carrying distance and whether you need helpers, disassembly, assembly or packing. In Aveiro, the service may involve central areas, residential areas, houses and access conditions conditioned by the distance between the parking lot and the entrance.
key_points: Identify the specific collection and delivery area.
Confirm where the vehicle can stop at each location.
Describe floors, lifts, stairs, gates, and garages.
Send photos of large furniture and difficult access.
Compare quotes based on the same load and the same tasks.

sections.heading: Areas and access conditions in Aveiro
paragraphs: The generic indication of “Aveiro” may not be enough to evaluate the change. The specific area influences the vehicle's approach, the manual route and the time required.
Indicate the location at both ends and separately describe the collection and delivery access points.

items.title: Center of Aveiro
items.text: Confirm circulation, parking, floors, lifts and distance to the entrance.

items.title: Gloria and Vera Cruz
items.text: Indicate the correct building, garage, access points and possible charging point.

items.title: Sneak

items.title: Aradas and São Bernardo
items.text: Provide exact location and confirm residential access, yards and maneuvering space.

sections.heading: How to prepare inventory for moving in Aveiro
paragraphs: Organize the load by rooms or categories and separate furniture, appliances, boxes and special items.
Indicate approximate measurements and send photographs when there are doubts about doors, stairs or lifts.

items.title: Furniture
items.text: List beds, mattresses, sofas, tables, cabinets, bookshelves and other large furniture.

items.title: Household Appliances
items.text: Identify refrigerator, machines, television and other relevant equipment.

items.title: Boxes
items.text: Indicate an approximate quantity and highlight fragile or especially heavy boxes.

items.title: Special items
items.text: Mark heavy, fragile, valuable or difficult-to-move items.

sections.heading: Access and parking in Aveiro
paragraphs: In Aveiro, the service may involve central areas, residential areas, houses and access conditions conditioned by the distance between the parking lot and the entrance.
When the vehicle cannot approach the entrance, indicate the distance, slope, steps and type of pavement of the route.
checklist: Existence and approximate dimensions of the elevator.
Possible place to stop the vehicle.
Distance between the vehicle and the entrance.

sections.heading: Services that must be defined
paragraphs: The quote must indicate the vehicle, the number of helpers, loading, unloading and protection of items.
Disassembly, assembly, packing, materials and additional equipment must be agreed in advance.

items.title: Helpers
items.text: Confirm how many people will participate in loading and unloading.

items.title: Disassembly and assembly
items.text: Identify the furniture covered and who will perform each task.

items.title: Packing and protection
items.text: Confirm the materials planned for furniture, appliances and fragile items.

items.title: Additional equipment
items.text: Inform about heavy parts or access that may require specific means.

sections.heading: How to compare quotes for a move in Aveiro
paragraphs: Send the same description to all carriers, including location, inventory, access and tasks.
Compare the price together with the vehicle, the team, the services included and the conditions presented.
checklist: The origin and destination are the same.
The number of helpers is indicated.
The price and conditions are recorded in writing.

faq.question: Is it enough to just indicate that the move is in Aveiro?
faq.answer: No. Please indicate the specific area or street when collecting and delivering, as access may vary.

faq.question: What details should I confirm about the property?
faq.answer: Check floors, stairs, doors, hallways, lifts, gates and garage access.

faq.question: Does the distance to the vehicle influence the service?
faq.answer: Yes. A long, inclined route or with steps can increase the time and number of helpers needed.

faq.question: When should I send photos?
faq.answer: Send photographs of large furniture, special items and access points that are difficult to describe.

faq.question: How to compare different quotes?
faq.answer: Confirm that they all consider the same load, the same access, helpers and additional services.
